title: Developer Experience Initiative Hub and Sprint Traffic-Light Portfolio
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Build a centralized Initiative Hub and sprint health portfolio for Developer Experience programs (SDKs, docs, quickstarts). The hub will consolidate signals (adoption, error rates, onboarding conversion, support tickets), surface per-initiative health using a traffic-light model (green/amber/red), and provide rollout/rollback playbooks and OKR mapping. The goal is to give PMs, Eng, and Design a single-pane view to prioritize runway for Q2 launches, coordinate canaries, and detect regressions early. Deliverables: 1) Initiative Hub page in Confluence + lightweight UI prototype inside Console; 2) ETL to populate metrics from telemetry, support, and GitHub; 3) traffic-light rules and escalation flows; 4) standard rollout checklist templates (canary metrics, cohort windows, notify lists); 5) integration with evaluation harness to flag quality regressions tied to prompt sets.
acceptance_criteria: Initiative Hub design doc and Console prototype available in Confluence and linked in ticket
Automated pipeline ingesting 4 core signals (activation, error-rate, PR velocity, support volume) into a DevX dashboard
Traffic-light status computed nightly and viewable per-initiative with rationale and last-changed timestamp
Two rollout checklist templates (quickstart, SDK release) approved by Eng and Design
Alerting/escalation playbook documented and tested end-to-end with one canary rollout
